title: Leome and Partners word reveal
description: Inline text whose words rise out of clipping masks: once on page load with a staggered expo ease, or scrubbed as each word scrolls into view, so whole lines rise together and the next line follows. Pure CSS, no text splitting by JavaScript.
notes: takes font, size and colour from its parent; put it inside the heading or paragraph
view mode uses CSS scroll-driven animations; without support the text stands still
